findings.entity: Bedroom doorway and exterior hallway wall
findings.description: After entering the bedroom at 00:03-00:04, the camera pans left by only ~110 degrees (from the right-side double windows, across the bed, to the left wall) rather than turning 180 degrees back toward the entry doorway. Despite this partial turn, an exit doorway appears on the left wall that looks straight down the hallway toward the far white door in the original walking direction, and the framed floral print from the exterior hallway wall (00:02) is now hanging inside the bedroom to the left of the doorway (00:07).

When emerging from the bedroom doorway back into the kitchen/hallway at 00:08-00:09, the architectural and appliance layout has mutated compared to 00:00-00:02: a microwave is now mounted above the stove on the left wall (replacing the range hood seen at 00:01, while the microwave was previously on the right-hand counter at 00:00), the dividing archway between the kitchen and hallway is gone, and the far door now has bare glass panes with a framed picture on the wall to its right.
